How your entry is handled

Your submission is encrypted in your browser before it is sent, so the service storing it cannot read it. Only the person holding the key can — and that key is not kept online. Your username is not stored in the clear anywhere.

Before submitting, compare the key fingerprint with the one pinned in the group. If they differ, do not submit and tell an administrator.
